summary: Davis, California, cognitive neuroscientist, post-doctoral fellow, expertise in neuroscience of episodic memory, strong interest in machine learning applications in neuroscience, advocates for universal basic income, libertarian leanings, experienced in Linux and programming (Python, Bash), family-oriented, has children, grew up in poverty, emphasizes the importance of education and support systems, engaged in discussions about social justice and economic inequality, frequent commenter on topics related to cognitive psychology and neuroscience research.
